targeted_requirements.quote: The driver of a vehicle approaching an intersection shall yield the right-of-way to a vehicle which has entered the intersection from a different highway. Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4], this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn.
targeted_requirements.rationale: Record the other vehicle's entry, ego's continuing approach and ego's response granting precedence.

reviewed_evidence_plan.active_setup: Construct crossing routes from different highways with the other vehicle already entering while ego approaches. Include runs where ego reduces progress to grant precedence.
